time-volume-mass-skill-01.skill: Telling Time to the Nearest Minute
time-volume-mass-skill-01.target: I can read and write time to the nearest minute on an analog clock and a digital clock.
time-volume-mass-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can read and write time to the nearest minute on an analog clock and a digital clock.
time-volume-mass-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Reading the hour hand as the next hour too early, or reading the minute hand’s number as minutes (on the 4 → 4 minutes). Try this: Count minutes by 5s around the clock, then by 1s; check that the hour hand is between two numbers.

time-volume-mass-skill-02.target: I can find a start time, end time, or elapsed time in minutes using a number line or a clock.
time-volume-mass-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can find a start time, end time, or elapsed time in minutes using a number line or a clock.
time-volume-mass-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Treating an hour as 100 minutes, or subtracting times like whole numbers across the hour. Try this: Use an open number line: jump to the next hour, then jump the rest, and add the jumps.

time-volume-mass-skill-03.target: I can read a liquid volume on a scaled container and estimate liquid volumes in liters.
time-volume-mass-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can read a liquid volume on a scaled container and estimate liquid volumes in liters.
time-volume-mass-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Reading each tick as 1 liter when the scale counts by 2s or 5s. Try this: Find the value of one tick first: count the spaces between two labeled marks.

time-volume-mass-skill-04.skill: Measuring Mass in Grams and Kilograms
time-volume-mass-skill-04.target: I can read a mass on a scale, choose grams or kilograms, and estimate the mass of everyday objects.
time-volume-mass-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can read a mass on a scale, choose grams or kilograms, and estimate the mass of everyday objects.
time-volume-mass-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Choosing kilograms for light objects because the number would be smaller, or mixing up mass and size. Try this: Use benchmarks: a paper clip is about 1 gram; a large book is about 1 kilogram.

time-volume-mass-skill-05.skill: Liquid Volume and Mass Word Problems
time-volume-mass-skill-05.target: I can add, subtract, multiply, or divide to solve one-step word problems with masses or liquid volumes in the same units.
time-volume-mass-skill-05.ifCorrect: You can do this: can add, subtract, multiply, or divide to solve one-step word problems with masses or liquid volumes in the same units.
time-volume-mass-skill-05.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Leaving off units or using the wrong operation for comparing amounts. Try this: Draw a beaker or tape diagram, label the units, and write an equation.
